comment: The settings of {{name}}. This is the one file the engine is told from: change it, then run the step that reads it. Every key that is left out takes its default. What each key means is in the skill's rules/settings.md, and example/brand/brand.json is a finished one. Before the logos can be made, the name needs a font: add "type" with a "family" to build, or a "wordmark" font file (rules/colour-type.md).
